note: Gold answers and accept_patterns are for grading only. build_prompt() sends the reader the rewritten prose and the question text, nothing else.

questions.question: What does the held-out answer template control rule out?
questions.gold: That the scorer is really reading the answer token or the surface form of the prompt.

questions.question: What exactly is the deterministic random item score baseline?
questions.gold: A hash of each item identifier to a scalar in 0 to 1, used as that item's score. No vector in activation space is sampled.

questions.question: Does that baseline test arbitrary directions in activation space?
questions.gold: No. No vector in activation space is ever sampled, so it says nothing about arbitrary directions.

questions.question: Why do the third-band rows equal exactly zero, and are they evidence about the model?
questions.gold: They are zero analytically because the interaction annihilates additive scores. They are estimator validity checks, not evidence about the model.

questions.question: Does this figure establish specificity against other semantic directions such as truth or sentiment?
questions.gold: No. M1 fits only the relation direction; that comparison belongs to the later intervention work.

questions.question: Does this figure establish that an arbitrary direction in the residual stream would fail to produce the effect?
questions.gold: No. M1 contains no such control.

questions.question: What does the figure positively establish?
questions.gold: That the effect is not wording, not answer format, and not an artefact of the board algebra.
